name: Zung Jung
description: Zung Jung is a modern Mahjong ruleset designed around transparent balanced scoring while preserving traditional draw-discard meld play. It is widely used when players want a structured alternative to many divergent house systems.

overview.description: Zung Jung is a modern Mahjong ruleset designed around transparent balanced scoring while preserving traditional draw-discard meld play. It is widely used when players want a structured alternative to many divergent house systems.

history.origins: Zung Jung was designed as a coherent modern scoring framework for Mahjong with explicit pattern values and clear hand evaluation logic.
timeline: Modern era: scoring system published and circulated in organized communities.
Current: adopted in many clubs and online rule discussions as a structured variant.
history.cultural: It is used by players who prefer clear competition-style pattern valuation.
history.evolution: The ruleset emphasizes clarity, consistency, and reduced scoring ambiguity compared with mixed house-rule environments.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honors, and optional bonus tiles.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and opens with a discard.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand and score according to the Zung Jung scoring table.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard in turn, with legal claims for Chow, Pung, and Kong according to normal claim restrictions. A hand wins when structural completion and scoring validity are achieved under this ruleset.
keyRules: Normal turn rhythm is draw then discard.
Claim legality and priority govern interruption windows.
Winning requires valid structure and recognized scoring pattern composition.

strategy.basic: Build efficient waits before chasing expensive pattern branches.
strategy.intermediate: Track exposed tiles to estimate both completion probability and danger.
strategy.advanced: Use scoring-table awareness to decide when to pivot between speed and value lines.
tips: Avoid overextending into low-probability high-value routes.
Defensive discipline matters when opponents signal near-completion.

synthesis.shortDescription: Zung Jung is a modern balanced Mahjong framework with explicit pattern values and classic draw-discard meld flow.
